verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own docs say it runs the official ClickHouse engine with "same SQL, same clients" and plain MergeTree DDL. That documents a native SQL surface rather than a bolt-on one. However, nothing in the pack names any of the specific analytical features the story asks for. missing for 10: explicit evidence of window functions, CTEs, semi-structured JSON support, array types/functions, rich date/time types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
